title: 73. The complete guide to therapy in your 20’s

sentences.en: This is an iHeart Podcast, Guaranteed Human.
sentences.zh: 这是一个 iHeart 播客，保证由真人制作。

sentences.en: I've been really trying to prioritize my health in a realistic way this year, and something that has kept me really motivated is my WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 今年我一直在努力以务实的方式优先考虑自己的健康，而让我保持动力的一个因素就是我的 WHOOP。

sentences.en: I am such a data person, which is why I love WHOOP, because I can genuinely see why my body feels differently depending on the day, why I'm running differently,
sentences.zh: 我是一个非常注重数据的人，这就是我喜欢 WHOOP 的原因，因为我可以清楚地看到为什么我的身体在不同日子里会有不同的感觉，为什么我的跑步状态会有所不同，

sentences.en: why I'm maybe less focused.
sentences.zh: 为什么我有时注意力不够集中。

sentences.en: WHOOP effortlessly tracks my sleep, it tracks my strain, my recovery, my stress, and most importantly, my overall health.
sentences.zh: WHOOP 可以轻松追踪我的睡眠、身体压力、恢复情况、压力水平，最重要的是，我的整体健康状况。

sentences.en: And it just gives me all that data and all those patterns so I can make better decisions, which includes knowing when to go easy and knowing when to go hard.
sentences.zh: 它为我提供了所有这些数据和模式，让我能够做出更好的决策，包括知道何时该放松，何时该努力。

sentences.en: New members can try WHOOP with a 30-day free trial before committing to a membership.
sentences.zh: 新用户可以在订阅会员之前，通过 30 天免费试用体验 WHOOP。

sentences.en: That's join.whoop.com slash psychology for your free month of WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 访问 join.whoop.com/psychology 即可获得一个月的免费 WHOOP 体验。

sentences.en: Some people keep all their old gig tickets.
sentences.zh: 有些人会保留他们所有的旧演出门票。

sentences.en: It brings back the music.
sentences.zh: 它能唤回音乐。

sentences.en: It brings back the memories, even the smells.
sentences.zh: 它能唤回记忆，甚至连气味都能唤回。

sentences.en: Other people collect perfume bottles or coffee mugs or overseas banknotes, classic sweaters from the 80s.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则收集香水瓶、咖啡杯、外国纸币，或是 80 年代的经典毛衣。

sentences.en: Collection is deeply personal.
sentences.zh: 收藏是非常私人的事。

sentences.en: It says who we are, but it also says where we've come from.
sentences.zh: 它不仅诉说着我们是谁，也诉说着我们从何而来。

sentences.en: In the new podcast, Charmed with Sam Todd,
sentences.zh: 在新的播客《Charmed with Sam Todd》中，

sentences.en: Sam explores the memories, obsessions, and tiny treasures that become part of who we are.
sentences.zh: Sam 探索了那些成为我们生命一部分的记忆、执念和微小的珍宝。

sentences.en: Charmed with Sam Todd.
sentences.zh: 很高兴认识山姆·托德。

sentences.en: Stories want to tell with Pandora.
sentences.zh: 与 Pandora 共同讲述的故事。

sentences.en: Listen to the podcast now on iHeart.
sentences.zh: 现在就在 iHeart 上收听该播客。

sentences.en: And welcome back to The Psychology of Your 20s, the podcast where we talk through some of the big life changes and transitions of our 20s and what they mean for our psychology.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到《二十岁的心理学》，在这个播客中，我们探讨二十岁时经历的一些重大生活变迁和过渡，以及它们对我们心理意味着什么。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到本播客。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到节目。

sentences.en: New listeners, old listeners, wherever you are in the world, thank you for joining me.
sentences.zh: 无论你是新听众还是老听众，无论你身处世界何方，感谢你的加入。

sentences.en: Thank you for joining me for another episode.
sentences.zh: 感谢你加入我的又一期节目。

sentences.en: This week, we are talking about therapy, and we're extending a discussion that we've had quite a bit over on The Psychology of Your 20s Instagram.
sentences.zh: 本周我们讨论的是心理咨询，我们将延伸探讨在《二十岁的心理学》Instagram 上已经讨论过很多次的话题。

sentences.en: So if you're following me over there, you may have seen some of these conversations come up a bit recently, but after mulling it over a little bit more,
sentences.zh: 如果你关注了我的账号，可能最近已经看到过这些对话，但在深入思考之后，

sentences.en: I thought we needed to devote an entire episode to this topic, especially as a podcast that is devoted to those of us in our 20s.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们需要专门用一期节目来讨论这个话题，尤其是作为一个致力于服务二十岁人群的播客。

sentences.en: Therapy is such a crucial resource for this decade, but also very confusing if you haven't been exposed to this type of help before.
sentences.zh: 心理咨询是这个十年里至关重要的资源，但如果你以前从未接触过这种帮助，它也会让人感到非常困惑。

sentences.en: You know, these years of our life, they are defined by so many huge life changes, disruptive events, breakups, breakdowns, even death sometimes,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们人生的这些年，是由许多重大的生活变迁、破坏性事件、分手、崩溃，有时甚至是死亡所定义的，

sentences.en: and it's often when we begin to recognize the trauma we have carried since childhood, the behaviours that may be self-sabotaging, the boundaries we find it difficult to set,
sentences.zh: 而且往往是在这个时候，我们开始意识到自己从童年起就背负的创伤、可能存在的自我破坏行为、难以设定的界限，

sentences.en: and the aspects of our mental health that we may be struggling with.
sentences.zh: 以及我们可能正在挣扎的心理健康问题。

sentences.en: And in these situations, reaching out for professional help is one of the best things you can do for your development and long-term mental health.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，寻求专业帮助是你为个人成长和长期心理健康所能做的最好的事情之一。

sentences.en: So, welcome everyone to your comprehensive audio guide to therapy in your 20s.
sentences.zh: 所以，欢迎大家来到这份关于二十岁心理咨询的综合音频指南。

sentences.en: If you're listening to this with the intention of getting some professional psychological assistance for whatever you're struggling with, I really hope it goes without saying
sentences.zh: 如果你听这期节目是为了寻求专业心理援助来解决你所面临的困境，我真心希望无需多言，

sentences.en: that I am so proud of you that this is a fantastic decision and you deserve so much credit for taking this step on your mental health journey.
sentences.zh: 我也要告诉你，我为你感到骄傲，这是一个非常棒的决定，你迈出心理健康之旅的这一步，值得极大的赞赏。

sentences.en: There is no shame, no stigma here because I genuinely think that everyone should receive therapy and I wish it was more accessible and less stigmatized than it is.
sentences.zh: 这里没有羞耻，也没有偏见，因为我真心认为每个人都应该接受心理咨询，我希望它能比现在更普及，更少被污名化。

sentences.en: I get so many messages from people who are really struggling to find affordable help or someone in their local area who isn't booked out for the next five months.
sentences.zh: 我收到很多人的留言，他们真的很难找到负担得起的帮助，或者很难找到当地没有排满未来五个月预约的咨询师。

sentences.en: I think accessibility is a massive issue impacting the mental health community, impacting people with mental health problems or conditions, especially after the pandemic
sentences.zh: 我认为可及性是一个巨大的问题，影响着心理健康群体，影响着有心理健康问题或疾病的人，特别是在疫情之后，

sentences.en: and the lockdowns when the demand for mental health services really skyrocketed.
sentences.zh: 以及封锁期间，心理健康服务的需求确实激增。

sentences.en: And I know it can be so frustrating, but I want to provide all of the information that I can for those who may be thinking about committing to therapy because we know anecdotally
sentences.zh: 我知道这可能会让人非常沮丧，但我希望能为那些考虑进行心理咨询的人提供我所能提供的一切信息，因为我们从经验中，

sentences.en: and from all the evidence that it really does have the capacity to change our lives.
sentences.zh: 以及从所有证据中都知道，它确实有改变我们生活的能力。

sentences.en: And like I had just mentioned before, there are so many financial and logistical reasons sometimes for stopping us.
sentences.zh: 正如我刚才提到的，有时有很多经济和后勤方面的原因阻碍着我们。

sentences.en: And one of those logistical reasons, one of those other reasons, I guess, is that it can be really scary and novel and new.
sentences.zh: 我想，其中一个后勤原因，或者说其他原因之一，是它可能让人感到非常害怕、陌生和新鲜。

sentences.en: There is so much stigma about being deemed crazy because you're taking care of your mental health.
sentences.zh: 因为照顾自己的心理健康而被视为“疯子”，这存在着太多的污名。

sentences.en: And that message is in no way supported by this platform.
sentences.zh: 而这种观点在我们的平台上绝不被支持。

sentences.en: We are pro-therapy.
sentences.zh: 我们支持心理咨询。

sentences.en: We are pro-seeking help.
sentences.zh: 我们支持寻求帮助。

sentences.en: You're not weak for going to therapy.
sentences.zh: 去咨询并不代表你软弱。

sentences.en: You're not crazy.
sentences.zh: 你并不疯。

sentences.en: I just think that everyone should be able to easily find their way into receiving psychological help when they need it.
sentences.zh: 我只是认为每个人在需要时都应该能够轻松地获得心理帮助。

sentences.en: So today, I really want to break down every element of the therapy journey so that it can be perhaps a little bit easier for you and for anyone listening
sentences.zh: 所以今天，我真的想拆解心理咨询之旅的每一个环节，让它对你以及任何正在收听的人来说稍微容易一点，

sentences.en: and get us closer to the point where getting psychological help is as easy as going to your family doctor.
sentences.zh: 并让我们离“获得心理帮助就像去看家庭医生一样简单”的目标更近一步。

sentences.en: So we're going to discuss a lot of things, a lot of crucial elements of the therapy journey of how to access therapy.
sentences.zh: 所以我们将讨论很多事情，讨论心理咨询之旅中许多至关重要的环节，以及如何获得心理咨询。

sentences.en: We're going to start off by talking about how to recognize when you may need therapy and some extra mental health assistance, how to access therapy and offering a bit of a guide
sentences.zh: 我们将从如何识别你可能需要心理咨询和额外的心理健康援助开始，谈谈如何获得心理咨询，并提供一份指南，

sentences.en: into those first early steps.
sentences.zh: 涵盖最初的几个步骤。

sentences.en: I really want to talk about the different types of therapy or counseling that you may be able to access and why they differ, how to find the right therapist
sentences.zh: 我真的想谈谈你可能接触到的不同类型的心理咨询或治疗，以及它们为何不同，如何找到合适的咨询师，

sentences.en: and why it may take a little while to find the right person for you.
sentences.zh: 以及为什么找到适合你的人可能需要一点时间。

sentences.en: I really want to talk about some of my non-negotiables around the people that I see for my mental health or the therapist that I speak to when I do find
sentences.zh: 我真的想谈谈我在选择心理健康咨询对象时的一些“底线”，或者当我发现自己需要额外帮助时，

sentences.en: that I need some extra assistance.
sentences.zh: 我与咨询师沟通时的一些原则。

sentences.en: So we're going to talk through that and then what to expect at therapy, especially in your first few sessions and some of the myths that surround this practice.
sentences.zh: 所以我们将讨论这些，然后谈谈在心理咨询中会发生什么，特别是在最初的几次会谈中，以及围绕这种实践的一些误区。

sentences.en: You know, it's not always like the movies where a person lays on a couch and we examine their dreams and you're not always going to be having breakthrough after breakthrough,
sentences.zh: 你知道，它并不总是像电影里那样，一个人躺在沙发上，我们分析他们的梦，你也不会总是每次会谈都有突破性的进展，

sentences.en: you know, in tears every session or walking out magically changed.
sentences.zh: 或者每次都泪流满面，或者走出来时就奇迹般地改变了。

sentences.en: I think we sometimes expect that when we go and, you know, get help.
sentences.zh: 我想我们有时在去寻求帮助时会有这样的期待。

sentences.en: And it's a really lovely promise and super appealing, but it doesn't always work out that way.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常美好的承诺，也非常吸引人，但事实并非总是如此。

sentences.en: And I think it's important to be realistic about what you can expect and about how therapy works and that it takes some time.
sentences.zh: 我认为重要的是要对你的期望保持现实，了解心理咨询是如何运作的，并且它需要一些时间。

sentences.en: And as someone who has done a lot of therapy, I run a psychology podcast,
sentences.zh: 作为一个做过很多心理咨询的人，我经营着一个心理学播客，

sentences.en: I've had my fair share of therapists, of psychologists and, you know, I've had my hiatuses.
sentences.zh: 我也有过不少咨询师、心理学家，而且，你知道，我也有过中断的时候。

sentences.en: I've gone back to therapy.
sentences.zh: 我后来又回到了咨询中。

sentences.en: I've seen different people for different issues.
sentences.zh: 我针对不同的问题见过不同的人。

sentences.en: So I really want to sit down today and outline in detail what this process is like.
sentences.zh: 所以我今天真的想坐下来，详细概述这个过程是什么样的。

sentences.en: And I hope that it will remove some of the mysticism and fear around what I think is really an essential practice for everyone and hopefully normalize
sentences.zh: 我希望这能消除围绕这一我认为对每个人都至关重要的实践的神秘感和恐惧，并希望能够让“寻求帮助”以及“获得所需支持”的过程常态化。

sentences.en: the process of asking for help and then receiving what you need.
sentences.zh: 所以今天的内容很多。

sentences.en: So there is a lot to cover today.
sentences.zh: 我要停止废话了。

sentences.en: So I'm going to stop waffling.
sentences.zh: 我要停止说话，让我们直接进入关于二十岁心理咨询的完整指南。

sentences.en: I'm going to stop talking and let's get straight into our complete guide to therapy in your 20s.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在听这期节目，你已经迈出了第一大步。

sentences.en: If you are listening to this, you've already taken the first major step.
sentences.zh: 恭喜你。

sentences.en: Congratulations.
sentences.zh: 你已经能够承认，你可能无法独自应对你所经历的一切。

sentences.en: You have been able to acknowledge that you may not be able to go through whatever you're going through on your own.
sentences.zh: 这是一种了不起的自我觉察。

sentences.en: That is amazing self-awareness.
sentences.zh: 我希望无需多言，就像我之前说的，我为你感到非常骄傲。

sentences.en: And I hope it goes without saying, like I said before, that I'm very proud of you.
sentences.zh: 生活有时会非常激烈。

sentences.en: Life can be really intense sometimes.
sentences.zh: 它可能会给我们抛出一些真正的“曲线球”，我们可以称之为重大生活事件，例如家庭成员的去世、慢性病诊断。

sentences.en: It can throw us some real curveballs that we might call major life events, such as the death of a family member, a chronic illness diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 但有时，日常生活的累积压力也会增加到我们需要停下来照顾自己心理健康的程度。

sentences.en: But sometimes the cumulative stress of everyday life can also build up to the point where we need to pause and look after our mental health.
sentences.zh: 我认为在深入探讨之前，也值得认识到，我们的家人和朋友能做的毕竟有限。

sentences.en: I think it's also worth recognizing before we jump in that our family and friends can only do so much.
sentences.zh: 他们也有自己的挣扎和影响他们心理健康的事情。

sentences.en: They have their own struggles and things impacting their mental health.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，指望我们在困难时期总是依赖他们是不现实的，至少不能满足我们所有的情感需求。

sentences.en: And I think it's not always realistic that we can always rely on them in hard times, not for all of our emotional needs, at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 他们也只是在尽力而为。

sentences.en: We're just doing our beSt.
sentences.zh: 有时，你知道，我们需要那种外部的支持，特别是在你甚至没有那种家庭支持，或者你的父母或亲近的人不认为心理健康是一个严重问题的情况下。

sentences.en: Sometimes, you know, we need that outside support, especially in instances where you may not even have that level of family support or recognition from your parents
sentences.zh: 没有那种我们所需要的必要支持和认可，真的非常困难。

sentences.en: or people that are close to you that mental health is a serious concern.
sentences.zh: 但在上述两种情况下，心理学家或咨询师都能提供巨大的价值、巨大的认可，提供心理技能，甚至提供理解你所经历的事情并将其传达给他人所需的语言。

sentences.en: And that is so hard to not have that essential support and validation that we need.
sentences.zh: 心理咨询也是完全保密的。

sentences.en: But in both of those instances, a psychologist or a therapist can provide so much value, so much validation, the psychological skills, and even the language to understand
sentences.zh: 没有评判。

sentences.en: what you're going through and communicate that to others.
sentences.zh: 你通常是为这种支持付费的。

sentences.en: Therapy is also entirely confidential.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以要求从会谈中获得你想要的东西，这是一个可以完全脆弱的地方，以一种我们有时无法与家人或朋友相处的方式，让你远离外部世界来处理你的情绪。

sentences.en: There is no judgment.
sentences.zh: 所以让我们谈谈你可能正在考虑或应该考虑心理咨询的一些迹象或原因。

sentences.en: You are often paying for this support.
sentences.zh: 第一个原因是如果你刚刚经历了一件重大生活事件。

sentences.en: So you get to ask for what you would like from your sessions and it is a place to be entirely vulnerable in a way that sometimes we cannot be with our family or friends
sentences.zh: 这些可能包括伴侣或家庭成员的去世、被解雇、大学毕业等。

sentences.en: to process your emotions away from the outside world.
sentences.zh: 并不是所有这些都必须是负面的，但它们都代表了一个计划外的、不可控的事件，通常标志着重大的生活变迁。

sentences.en: So let's talk about some of the signs or reasons that you might be considering or should consider therapy.
sentences.zh: 实际上，网上有一份“十大最令人压力的生活事件”量表，其中一些甚至包括像结婚或搬家这样的积极事情。

sentences.en: The first reason is if you've just been through a major life event.
sentences.zh: 当这些事件发生时，我们经历某种程度的压力甚至痛苦的可能性就会增加。

sentences.en: These may include things like the death of a partner, of a family member, being fired, graduating uni.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它们需要巨大的适应。

sentences.en: Even, not all of them have to be negative, but they do all represent an unscheduled, uncontrollable event that usually signifies a major life change.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你能意识到你的生活中刚刚发生了重大事件，无论你是否应对得过来，我认为都值得去寻求帮助，看看是否能找人寻求指导。

sentences.en: There is actually a scale of the 10 most stressful life events that you can access online and some of them even include positive things like a wedding or moving house.
sentences.zh: 第二个原因是压倒性的压力和焦虑。

sentences.en: And when these events occur, there is a heightened likelihood that we are going to experience some level of stress or even distress.
sentences.zh: 也许你在工作或大学里长时间工作，难以应付各种事情。

sentences.en: You know, they are a huge adjustment.
sentences.zh: 压力会对我们的神经系统和大脑的应对能力造成巨大的压力。

sentences.en: So if you can recognize that something major has just occurred in your life, whether you're coping or not, I think it's worth reaching out and seeing if you're able to see someone
sentences.zh: 如果不加以解决，它会显著增加你患上抑郁症和焦虑症等心理健康问题的可能性。

sentences.en: for some guidance.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你发现自己正遭受过度疲劳、焦虑、压力等问题的困扰，如果你经常生病，我认为这真的值得坐下来好好思考，

sentences.en: The second reason is overwhelming stress and anxiety.
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，退后一步，优先考虑你的心理健康并寻求帮助。

sentences.en: Maybe you're working extended hours at work or at uni and struggling to stay on top of things.
sentences.zh: 你知道，工作可以等。

sentences.en: Stress places immense pressure on our nervous system and our brain's ability to cope.
sentences.zh: 一次糟糕的成绩不会毁了你，相信我。

sentences.en: And if it's left unaddressed, it significantly increases your likelihood of developing mental health problems like depression and anxiety.
sentences.zh: 但糟糕的心理健康所带来的后果，将比你的学业表现或升职机会持续得更久。

sentences.en: So if you are finding that you're suffering from things like excessive fatigue, anxiety, stress, if you're getting sick very often, that's really worth, I think, sitting with,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，确保通过与人交谈来处理你的情绪和压力，找到你需要的帮助，意味着你可以更快地恢复，达到你想要的运作水平。

sentences.en: taking a step back if you can and prioritizing your mental health and getting some help.

sentences.zh: 那么接下来该期待什么呢？

sentences.en: How do you go about entering into your first few sessions?
sentences.zh: 你应该如何开始前几次咨询？

sentences.en: And what are some of the things that you shouldn't expect?
sentences.zh: 以及有哪些事情是你不需要期待的？

sentences.en: All of that and more in just one second.
sentences.zh: 所有这些以及更多内容，马上就来。

sentences.en: Entering into your first psychology appointment, your first therapy appointment, it can be really scary, especially if it's your first time or you don't really know what to expect.
sentences.zh: 第一次进行心理咨询或治疗预约可能会让人感到害怕，尤其是如果你是第一次去，或者不太清楚会发生什么。

sentences.en: But it's actually really simple.
sentences.zh: 但其实这非常简单。

sentences.en: It's nothing to be worried about at all.
sentences.zh: 完全不用担心。

sentences.en: Before jumping into what we would normally think of as therapy, the person you're seeing needs to lay a bit of groundwork and you're going to need to help them with that.
sentences.zh: 在进入我们通常认为的“治疗”环节之前，你见的人需要先做一些铺垫，而你需要配合他们完成这些。

sentences.en: So they may ask you some questions around whether you've been to therapy before, whether it was recommended to you by your workplace or another health care professional.
sentences.zh: 所以他们可能会问你一些问题，比如你以前是否做过心理咨询，或者你是通过工作单位还是其他医疗专业人士推荐来的。

sentences.en: And sometimes if you've been referred for a specific issue or condition, they might ask about your family history, what medications you're on, when you began noticing
sentences.zh: 如果你是因为特定的问题或状况被转介过来的，他们有时会询问你的家族病史、你正在服用的药物、你从什么时候开始注意到

sentences.en: symptoms, things like that.
sentences.zh: 症状，诸如此类的问题。

sentences.en: Just basic outline questions.
sentences.zh: 只是一些基本的概况性问题。

sentences.en: The typical first session, it's going to provide you with an opportunity to outline exactly why you are there.
sentences.zh: 典型的第一次咨询，会让你有机会准确地说明你为什么来这里。

sentences.en: What was the triggering event?
sentences.zh: 触发事件是什么？

sentences.en: What is the problem or the experience of concern?
sentences.zh: 困扰你的问题或经历是什么？

sentences.en: you might not have one or at least be able to label exactly what's wrong at that moment.
sentences.zh: 你可能还没想好，或者至少在那一刻无法准确说出哪里出了问题。

sentences.en: That is okay.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: If you're just feeling a little bit off, if you're not sure what's wrong, that is totally fine.
sentences.zh: 如果你只是感觉有点不对劲，不确定哪里出了问题，这完全没问题。

sentences.en: It should not stop you from going to see someone because a therapist or a psychologist, they are there to help you develop the language and the skills to identify exactly what
sentences.zh: 这不应该成为你去看医生的阻碍，因为治疗师或心理学家，他们就是为了帮助你建立语言和技能，从而准确识别出

sentences.en: you're going through.
sentences.zh: 你正在经历什么。

sentences.en: Or you may be on the other end of the spectrum and have tons, a number of topics that you want to discuss.
sentences.zh: 或者你可能处于另一个极端，有一大堆想讨论的话题。

sentences.en: That's okay as well.
sentences.zh: 那也没关系。

sentences.en: You can use your first session to outline these to your therapist and even better, take the opportunity to identify which of these things you're worried about, which
sentences.zh: 你可以利用第一次咨询向治疗师列出这些问题，更好的是，借此机会确定你最担心的是哪些，

sentences.en: of these things you want to address are most crucial and you would like to address firSt.
sentences.zh: 哪些是你最想优先解决的问题。

sentences.en: You may often find that some of them are actually very much interlinked and addressing the root cause of one might actually help with the other.
sentences.zh: 你经常会发现，其中一些问题其实是紧密相连的，解决了一个问题的根源，可能实际上有助于解决另一个问题。

sentences.en: Expect to do most of the talking, especially in those first sessions.
sentences.zh: 做好大部分时间由你来说的准备，尤其是在前几次咨询中。

sentences.en: You know, they want to know you.
sentences.zh: 你要知道，他们想了解你。

sentences.en: They want to know who you are.
sentences.zh: 他们想知道你是谁。

sentences.en: They want to be well informed about what you're worried about before they make any assumptions or judgments.
sentences.zh: 在做出任何假设或判断之前，他们希望充分了解你所担心的事情。

sentences.en: And if you're worried about keeping a conversation or whatnot, that's what they're trained to do.
sentences.zh: 如果你担心不知道该聊什么，别担心，他们受过这方面的专业训练。

sentences.en: They will ask you questions.
sentences.zh: 他们会问你问题。

sentences.en: They will ask you for more details.
sentences.zh: 他们会询问更多细节。

sentences.en: They will really probe.
sentences.zh: 他们会深入挖掘。

sentences.en: But obviously, if you're like, I'm not comfortable talking about that right now, it's all up to you.
sentences.zh: 但显然，如果你说“我现在不太想谈这个”，那完全取决于你。

sentences.en: You're in control.
sentences.zh: 掌控权在你手中。

sentences.en: If you exit your first session and you feel like, you know, I didn't have much to say, maybe
sentences.zh: 如果你结束了第一次咨询，感觉“我好像没什么可说的，也许

sentences.en: I'm fine, maybe I don't need help, like I kind of clammed shut, I would encourage you to go back a few more times.
sentences.zh: 我很好，也许我不需要帮助，我当时有点闭口不谈”，我还是鼓励你多去几次。

sentences.en: Sometimes it can take us some time to feel comfortable
sentences.zh: 有时候我们需要一些时间才能在新的环境中感到自在

sentences.en: and vulnerable in a new situation,
sentences.zh: 并敞开心扉，

sentences.en: especially with new people.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在面对陌生人时。

sentences.en: And if you don't find that you typically talk about these problems regularly, it can be an adjustment to recognize that you are in a safe, confidential space where the primary
sentences.zh: 如果你平时不习惯谈论这些问题，那么意识到自己身处一个安全、保密的空间，其主要

sentences.en: purpose, the primary goal is for you to speak freely and without judgment.
sentences.zh: 目的和目标就是让你自由地表达，且不会受到评判，这确实需要一个适应过程。

sentences.en: It takes time to build truSt.
sentences.zh: 建立信任需要时间。

sentences.en: So sometimes you do need to go back a few times and recognize, okay, well this is what I can expect, this is what this person is like,
sentences.zh: 所以有时候你确实需要多去几次，去确认：好吧，这就是我能期待的，这个人是这样的，

sentences.en: I'm safe here, I can say whatever I would like.
sentences.zh: 在这里我是安全的，我可以畅所欲言。

sentences.en: Furthermore, I think one of the huge misconceptions
sentences.zh: 此外，我认为一个巨大的误区是，

sentences.en: is that you're going to come out of every session and have experienced some huge revelation or a breakthrough.
sentences.zh: 你每次咨询完都会有某种重大的启示或突破。

sentences.en: Often, that is not the case, you know, the habits, the thoughts, the emotional reactions we experience on a day-to-day basis, they have been developed and conditioned over a
sentences.zh: 通常情况并非如此。你要知道，我们日常生活中经历的习惯、想法和情绪反应，都是在

sentences.en: very long period of time.
sentences.zh: 很长一段时间内形成和固化的。

sentences.en: So it is hard to unlearn these in just one or two sessions.
sentences.zh: 所以想在这一两次咨询中就改掉它们是很困难的。

sentences.en: Having massive realizations, it's not uncommon, but it's also not going to happen all of the time.
sentences.zh: 有重大的领悟并不罕见，但也不会时时刻刻发生。

sentences.en: So our brain is going to take time to adjust, to follow along, to understand, and if you're feeling a little bit confused or like, you know, you're not making this
sentences.zh: 所以我们的大脑需要时间去调整、去跟进、去理解。如果你感到有点困惑，或者觉得

sentences.en: massive progress, you're not seeing these massive changes in your life from the outset, you're not doing anything wrong.
sentences.zh: 自己没有取得巨大的进展，没有从一开始就看到生活发生翻天覆地的变化，你并没有做错什么。

sentences.en: Don't quit.
sentences.zh: 不要放弃。

sentences.en: It's not something to worry about.
sentences.zh: 这没什么好担心的。

sentences.en: Change, it takes time.
sentences.zh: 改变需要时间。

sentences.en: Breakthroughs take time.
sentences.zh: 突破需要时间。

sentences.en: They require a lot of foundation work, but they will come.
sentences.zh: 它们需要大量的铺垫工作，但终会到来。

sentences.en: And even if they're just going to come along a little bit quieter or less traumatic than you expected, they will happen if you commit to your mental health journey.
sentences.zh: 即使它们来得比你预期的更安静、更平淡，只要你致力于自己的心理健康之旅，它们就会发生。

sentences.en: And you know, therapy isn't going to fix everything.
sentences.zh: 而且你要知道，心理咨询并不能解决所有问题。

sentences.en: I think that's another big kind of disclaimer I would like to make, but what it will do is give you the necessary strategies and mental or emotional tools to fix those things
sentences.zh: 我认为这是我想做的另一个重要声明，但它能为你提供必要的策略和心理或情感工具，让你自己去

sentences.en: yourself.
sentences.zh: 解决这些问题。

sentences.en: And sometimes we just need someone to talk to.
sentences.zh: 有时候我们只是需要有人倾听。

sentences.en: There is this saying that a problem on a page is half a problem.
sentences.zh: 有句谚语说，把问题写在纸上，问题就解决了一半。

sentences.en: The same goes for verbalizing it.
sentences.zh: 说出来也是一样。

sentences.en: Often a lot of our worries come from thoughts and feelings that we have that have been suppressed.
sentences.zh: 我们很多烦恼往往源于那些被压抑的想法和感受。

sentences.en: And once you're able to get those out into the air, you'll feel a lot better.
sentences.zh: 一旦你能把它们倾诉出来，你会感觉好很多。

sentences.en: And in six months, I promise that you will notice a change as you begin to kind of see the world and your behaviors and yourself a lot differently week by week, month by month.
sentences.zh: 我保证，六个月后，你会注意到变化，因为你开始以完全不同的方式看待世界、你的行为和你自己，每周、每月都在改变。

sentences.en: But back to those first few sessions, if you have decided that you want to undergo a specific therapy or a specific route, your therapist will likely talk you through this
sentences.zh: 回到前几次咨询，如果你已经决定要进行某种特定的疗法或走特定的路线，你的治疗师很可能会和你讨论

sentences.en: with you.
sentences.zh: 这一点。

sentences.en: You know, they really want to be involved.
sentences.zh: 你要知道，他们真的很想参与其中。

sentences.en: That's obviously the point.
sentences.zh: 这显然是咨询的目的。

sentences.en: They're going to speak with you about the process, the steps, the reasoning and the evidence.
sentences.zh: 他们会和你讨论这个过程、步骤、背后的逻辑和依据。

sentences.en: For example, if you are like, okay, I have a massive phobia of snakes.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果你说：“好吧，我非常害怕蛇。”

sentences.en: It's really bothering me.
sentences.zh: 这真的很困扰我。

sentences.en: I can't go outside.
sentences.zh: 我没法出门。

sentences.en: I can't go on hikes.
sentences.zh: 我没法去徒步。

sentences.en: I can't enjoy nature because I'm so worried about it.
sentences.zh: 我没法享受大自然，因为我太担心了。

sentences.en: They might be like, okay, well, exposure therapy is really going to work here and they will talk you through exactly what it entails.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会说：“好吧，暴露疗法在这里会非常有效。”然后他们会详细向你解释这具体包含什么。

sentences.en: They may also offer alternative therapies or alternative treatments based on their professional judgment.
sentences.zh: 他们也可能根据专业判断提供替代疗法或替代治疗方案。

sentences.en: You can do your own research and be like, no, I don't want to go down that path.
sentences.zh: 你可以自己做研究，然后说：“不，我不想走那条路。”

sentences.en: No, I don't really want to do that.
sentences.zh: “不，我不太想做那个。”

sentences.en: It's completely up to you.
sentences.zh: 这完全取决于你。

sentences.en: But by the time that you've been there a few times, you should have a good understanding of what you're working towards and how your chosen mental health professional sees your
sentences.zh: 但当你去过几次之后，你应该对你的目标有一个很好的了解，知道你选择的心理健康专业人士是如何看待你的

sentences.en: issue or how they are going about addressing it and the process or the steps that are laid out in front of you in that first session as well.
sentences.zh: 问题，他们打算如何解决它，以及在第一次咨询中为你规划的过程或步骤。

sentences.en: If, for example, you're having a mental health crisis or you are really struggling with anxiety or depression, they may also offer some initial suggestions or skills to start
sentences.zh: 例如，如果你正处于心理健康危机中，或者正深受焦虑或抑郁的困扰，他们也可能会提供一些初步建议或技能，让你开始

sentences.en: working on and some activities that you should do between sessions.
sentences.zh: 着手练习，以及一些你应该在咨询间隙完成的活动。

sentences.en: Maybe it's practicing mindfulness.
sentences.zh: 也许是练习正念。

sentences.en: Maybe they will teach you specific calming techniques if you're panicking or recommend a specific journaling routine and it's your responsibility to complete these.
sentences.zh: 也许如果你感到恐慌，他们会教你具体的镇静技巧，或者推荐一套特定的日记记录习惯，而完成这些是你的责任。

sentences.en: They're not going to tell you off if you didn't do it.
sentences.zh: 如果你没做，他们不会责怪你。

sentences.en: It's up to you.
sentences.zh: 这取决于你自己。

sentences.en: But treat it like the most important homework you will ever do.
sentences.zh: 但请把它当作你这辈子做过的最重要的家庭作业来对待。

sentences.en: The most important homework of your life.
sentences.zh: 你人生中最重要的家庭作业。

sentences.en: It will be the things that your therapist assigns you to do.
sentences.zh: 这就是你的治疗师分配给你的任务。

sentences.en: I promise it's worth doing them.
sentences.zh: 我保证，完成它们是值得的。

sentences.en: After the first session, your therapist or psychologist, they will normally book you in for a next session if you decide they are the right person and you and them will
sentences.zh: 第一次咨询后，如果你们觉得彼此合适，你的治疗师或心理学家通常会为你预约下一次咨询，你们会

sentences.en: create either a weekly or a fortnightly schedule for you to see them regularly based on their schedule, based on your schedule.
sentences.zh: 根据双方的时间表，制定每周或每两周一次的定期咨询计划。

sentences.en: I think another huge misconception with therapy is that you have to be going like five times a week, like all the time to see, you know, to see those results when
sentences.zh: 我认为关于心理咨询的另一个巨大误区是，你必须每周去五次，一直去，才能看到那些效果，而

sentences.en: truly if you've found the right person for you, you can do a lot of the necessary work between your sessions and with their guidance.
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果你找到了适合你的人，你可以在咨询间隙，在他们的指导下完成很多必要的工作。

sentences.en: If after a little while you have a conversation and you don't really need to see them as regularly, you can always change to a monthly basis.
sentences.zh: 如果过了一段时间，你们沟通后发现不需要那么频繁地见面，你总是可以改为每月一次。

sentences.en: You don't have to stick to that schedule that you initially set and regardless of what happens, you can always go back even if you take a break.
sentences.zh: 你不必死守最初设定的时间表，无论发生什么，即使你中途休息，也随时可以回去。

sentences.en: You can stay in touch with your therapist even if you're not seeing them regularly, especially once that trust is built, it's important to know that you can rekindle that
sentences.zh: 即使你不定期去见治疗师，也可以保持联系，尤其是当信任建立起来后，重要的是要知道你可以重新开启那段

sentences.en: professional relationship.
sentences.zh: 专业关系。

sentences.en: However, that does not mean that you're going to be best pals and should be able to call them or text them in the middle of the night whenever you're having a problem.
sentences.zh: 然而，这并不意味着你们会成为最好的朋友，也不意味着你可以在半夜遇到问题时随意给他们打电话或发短信。

sentences.en: Remember, they are real people.
sentences.zh: 记住，他们也是普通人。

sentences.en: They are a trained, confidential, professional service, not a best friend.
sentences.zh: 他们提供的是一种受过专业训练的、保密的专业服务，而不是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: So make sure that you maintain healthy boundaries and expectations about what a therapist can really offer you and make sure that they are the right person for you.
sentences.zh: 所以，请确保保持健康的界限，对治疗师能为你提供什么有合理的预期，并确保他们确实是适合你的人。

sentences.en: I think that is the crucial message throughout this entire thing.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是贯穿整件事的关键信息。

sentences.en: Make sure they are the right person.
sentences.zh: 确保他们是适合你的人。

sentences.en: The growth that you will want to see, the changes you will want to see, they will not happen if you do not feel comfortable.
sentences.zh: 如果你感到不自在，你想要的成长和改变就不会发生。

sentences.en: They will not happen if you don't feel vulnerable enough to share what is actually really worrying you and if that person
sentences.zh: 如果你没有足够的安全感去分享真正困扰你的事情，如果那个人

sentences.en: doesn't have the training or the specific skill set that's going to meet your needs.
sentences.zh: 没有满足你需求的培训背景或特定技能，这些改变就不会发生。

sentences.en: Before we wrap up and to complete the guide, I really want to quickly address one more myth and that is that if you seek professional help, something must be wrong with you.
sentences.zh: 在结束本指南之前，我真的想快速澄清最后一个误区，那就是：如果你寻求专业帮助，一定是你出了什么问题。

sentences.en: You are broken, you are weak, whatever it is.
sentences.zh: 你崩溃了，你软弱，无论是什么原因。

sentences.en: Society has never been particularly kind to people who struggle with their mental health.
sentences.zh: 社会对那些与心理健康问题作斗争的人从来都不够友善。

sentences.en: There is a long history of stigma and maltreatment, but there is nothing wrong with you.
sentences.zh: 这背后有着悠久的污名化和虐待历史，但你并没有什么问题。

sentences.en: Nothing at all.
sentences.zh: 一点问题都没有。

sentences.en: Almost 25% of all people in the world will experience some form of mental health condition or struggle in their life.
sentences.zh: 世界上几乎25%的人一生中都会经历某种形式的心理健康状况或困扰。

sentences.en: And those numbers just come from the people who actually seek help.
sentences.zh: 而这些数字仅仅来自那些真正寻求帮助的人。

sentences.en: I'm guessing they would be so much higher than we can anticipate.
sentences.zh: 我猜实际数字会远超我们的预期。

sentences.en: You are not alone, you are certainly not weak.
sentences.zh: 你并不孤单，你也绝不软弱。

sentences.en: Going to therapy does not change anything about your value or who you are.
sentences.zh: 接受心理治疗并不会改变你的价值或你的本质。

sentences.en: If anything, it only makes you stronger and more well-equipped to deal with the rollercoaster of life.
sentences.zh: 相反，它只会让你变得更强大，更有能力去应对人生的起起落落。

sentences.en: So if you've made it this far, if you're considering therapy, please, please do it.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你已经读到这里，如果你正在考虑接受心理治疗，请务必去做。

sentences.en: There are always options out there, affordable help, therapy that's offered through your workplace, through your insurance, through government programs, through
sentences.zh: 总有很多选择，比如负担得起的帮助、通过工作场所提供的心理治疗、通过保险、通过政府项目、通过

sentences.en: online services, and you know, you don't need to announce it to the world if you don't feel comfortable, but I would also really, really encourage you to not let any
sentences.zh: 在线服务。你知道，如果你觉得不自在，不需要向全世界宣告，但我真的、真的鼓励你不要让任何

sentences.en: stigma stop you.
sentences.zh: 偏见阻碍你。

sentences.en: You're in the right place no matter what society thinks, your parents, your friends think, on this platform, no matter what you're going through, mental health will absolutely
sentences.zh: 无论社会、你的父母或朋友怎么想，你都来对地方了。在这个平台上，无论你正在经历什么，心理健康绝对

sentences.en: never be something to be ashamed of, and getting help is one of the most crucial things that you can do.
sentences.zh: 永远不该成为羞耻的事，寻求帮助是你所能做的最重要的事情之一。
